description: This PHP class, OrganizationDao, is a data access object responsible for retrieving and saving organization information in the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with entities like Organization and Subunit, and manages database transactions related to organization data.

classes.name: OrganizationDao
classes.description: Data access class for performing CRUD operations related to Organization entities, including transaction management and organization structure updates.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves the general information of the organization, returning the Organization entity or null if not found.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided Organization entity into the database, managing transactions and updating the organization structure accordingly.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Private method to update the organization's structure, specifically modifying the base unit name to match the organization's name.
